field_principles.exploration_actions_used: BARE int: actions the solver actually took in the env -- MUST be > 0 (the exp4307 GATE_PASSED_WITHOUT_DATA flag was exactly exploration_actions_used==0; a real solve takes real actions).
field_principles.game_advanced: The NEW game targeted (NOT r11l/ls20/wa30/sc25) -- the incremental-progress unit.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed. An advance (+1 offline-reproduced level on a new game), an honest no-advance WITH real exploration (exploration_actions_used>0, informs the next pick), and an honest blocked_arc_env_unreachable / blocked_arc_solver_cannot_act are ALL COMPLETE -- progress is the metric, but a real no-advance is decision-grade. A no-advance with 0 actions is the exp4307 flag to AVOID.
field_principles.levels_completed: BARE int: levels solved on this game from the solver's REAL-ENV output (NOT a self-report) -- the no-fabrication anchor.
field_principles.offline_reproduced: BARE bool: the level reproduces on the OFFLINE env via arc_solver_kit.reproduce() -- only reproduced levels count toward total_levels (ARC Solve Reproducibility Discipline).
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records the offline-env reachability + survey load + adapter-free solver; pre-empts the silent-missing-resource + frontier-adapter-dependency fabrication modes.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the solver trace + the env outcome + the reproduce() result; lets a third party re-run.
field_principles.total_levels: BARE int: the cumulative OFFLINE-REPRODUCED solved-level count -- MUST be monotonic (>= 22); the north-star accuracy metric (per ARC Solve Reproducibility, only reproduced levels count).

general_gotchas.note: Arcade(OFFLINE, environment_files) = deterministic sim, all 25 games, zero quota.
level = frame.levels_completed; env._game has no levels_completed.
env._game=deepcopy(state) works for lp85, BROKEN for sc25; use replay-from-reset.
first env.step after reset is a no-op (sc25); warm up after reset.
live-coupled hardcoded coords miss the offline layout; discover from env.
tank-controls facing + multi-frame animations; include facing/phase in the dedup key and resolve animations before win-check.

recommend_approach.guidance: Start from the top-ranked solved game's solver + reuse its action-model and gotchas; only reverse-engineer the DELTA. Import arc_solver_kit; run the reproduction gate; append new mechanics/dead-ends to the registry.

recommended.action_model: ACTION6 click to select spell (sptivk-{spell}) + toggle 3x3 cast cells at (24+5c,49+5r) [camera identity] + fire; ACTION1-4 move the player (tank-controls).
reusable_gotchas: first step after reset consumed -> warm-up step.
tank-controls: facing (jdmucabyqar) is load-bearing -> include in state-key.
live solver's SC25_GRID_COORDS are WRONG for the offline env; correct cell (r,c) = (24+5c, 49+5r).
spell fire clears the cast pattern; multi-frame fireball animation must resolve.
recommended.solver: scripts/arc3_sc25_offline_solver.py (v3, replay-from-reset BFS) — infra works, ~90 states explored, L1 blocked on the win-mechanic.
recommended.win_condition: MULTIPLE paths: (a) move player 'pluyoo' to exit 'exydhv' (abvgsmnbrj->next_level); (b) cast-grid alignment — align the 9 'clcbko' goal sprites to the 3x3 cast grid at +1,+1 (ianfrutkqg/mtfwxhxooqg). L1 is likely (b) or needs a fireball to clear a wall first.

recommended.action_model: ACTION6 click; full reset->win trajectory in the artifact replays offline.
recommended.win_condition: click-to-template: each colored piece dragged onto its gray template (+1,+1).

recommended.action_model: keyboard-only [ACTION4,4,4,5]; ACTION4 = one direction, ACTION5 commit.
recommended.win_condition: first-solve L1 adapter-free; move-right x3 then commit.
